MeasurementMethod.description: Position estimated by eye relative to the landmarks
Distances to the landmarks measured with a flexible tape
Distances measured with a caliper or anthropometer
Sensor and landmarks digitized with a 3D digitizer (e.g., electromagnetic or ultrasound probe)
Sensor and landmark positions measured with optical motion capture
Positions extracted from a 3D surface scan or photogrammetry
Nominal position taken from a protocol or template; not measured on the participant
Any other method; a Description is required

LandmarkIdentification.description: Landmark position digitized (e.g., with a probe or scanner)
Landmark inaccessible (e.g., covered by footwear); surrogate used and documented in SurrogateLandmarks

StandardReference.description: European recommendations for surface EMG electrode placement (Hermens et al., 1999)
ISB recommendations for anatomical and joint coordinate systems (Wu et al., 2002, 2005)
ISB recommendations for IMU-based joint kinematics (Cereatti et al., 2024)
Standard electrode positions of the 12-lead ECG
Torso placement of limb electrodes for exercise ECG (Mason & Likar, 1966)
Placement following the instructions of the device manufacturer
Laboratory-specific protocol; a reference or description is required
